name: Fine Dining
tagline: A dark, elegant template for a restaurant that takes reservations.
description: A complete, working site for a tasting-menu restaurant: a real seven-course menu with à la carte and wine pairing, and a live reservations flow (tables and a chef’s counter as bookable resources, party-size services, dinner-only hours, a per-cover deposit) on the /reserve page. Dark, candle-lit theme — warm charcoal, gold, copper. Pages: Home, Menu, Reserve, About, Visit. Shipped as Vesper.
